headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty rose as IT stocks led a 3% weekly market rally.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: Strong rally in IT stocks including Tech Mahindra and TCS led the weekly gains
Positive Q2 earnings reports from major lenders ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank
Strengthening of the Indian rupee against the dollar supported market sentiment
A massive 1,534-point rally earlier in the week provided strong upward momentum
whatHappening: FSSAI issued notices to Nestle India and HUL over allegedly misleading product claims
ICICI Bank reported a 20.1% rise in Q2 net profit to ₹14,843 crore
The government finalized a 30% trade margin cap for 137 non-scheduled cancer drugs
HDFC Bank's Q2 net profit grew 4.7% to ₹19,510 crore amid steady performance
summary: Indian markets concluded the week with a 3% gain, driven by a strong rally in IT stocks and robust Q2 earnings from ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank. While the broader market sentiment remained positive, FMCG giants Nestle India and HUL faced regulatory scrutiny from FSSAI over labelling violations. The market is currently closed for the weekend and the Dussehra holiday, with trading set to resume on Wednesday.
